name: Barbie Fashionistas
dimensions: Height 295 mm; Width 105 mm; Depth 50 mm; Height 325 mm
summary: Barbie Fashionistas Doll. Black with hair worn in long brunette braids. Dolls is designed to be curvier than the original Barbie doll body. Wearing gold hoop earrings, green short sleeved top with black leopard print, pink shorts, and white sandals. Mattel number 144.
